messages:
Maya Singh: Heads-up: planning a 75m change window to roll out the tf module for cross-account IAM mapping + transit gateway route shifts. Need a clear pin and a rollback ladder.

Ethan Brooks: Can we avoid touching shared route tables? If not, we should do staggered applies per AZ.

Maya Singh: We'll avoid route table deletes; plan will only add peering and route entries. Staggered by AZ makes sense.

Rosa Alvarez: Please paste the module ref and exact tfvars so I can add to release notes. Also need confirmation of provider pin.

Maya Singh: Module and tfvars snippet:
```
module "transit_connect" {
  source = "git::ssh://git@github.com/redwood-infra/modules.git//networking/transit?ref=hotfix/2026-03-transit-9f2d"
}

# tfvars.json
{
  "transit_gw_id": "tgw-0f1e2d3c4b",
  "cross_account_role": "arn:aws:iam::210987654321:role/redwood-xaccount-attach"
}
```

Maya Singh: Provider pin: `required_providers { aws = { version = "~> 4.62" } }`

Deploybot: Preflight: terraform plan will run in 5m; if >1 change to shared resources detected, plan will pause.

Ethan Brooks: I'll take the first AZ apply (us-west-2a). Rosa, can you take oncall for monitoring after the first AZ?

Rosa Alvarez: Yep. I'll watch BGP flaps and NAT metrics.

Maya Singh: Rollback ladder draft:
- Stop further AZ applies.
- Revert infra module ref to previous stable tag `release/2026-03-10-stable` and run `terraform apply -var-file=revert.tfvars.json`
- If route instability persists, fail traffic to fallback TGW (see runbook).

Ethan Brooks: Can we add a quick canary health test after each AZ? simple curl to internal health endpoints + traceroute check.

Rosa Alvarez: Adding smoke test commands to release notes and including alert thresholds.

ops-bot: @channel Don't forget to create a release tracker entry and attach plan output.

Maya Singh: Preflight plan result: no destructive changes. Scheduling AZ canary apply in 10m.

Ethan Brooks: AZ canary apply started (job=jt-9801). Posting plan block for review.

(4m later)
Ethan Brooks: AZ canary apply complete for us-west-2a. smoke tests pass. No BGP anomalies. logs: https://ci.internal/reports/jt-9801

Maya Singh: Good. Scheduling remaining AZs in 15m window. Locking tfvars and tagging infra commit with hotfix/2026-03-transit-9f2d.

Deploybot: prod apply queued (job=jt-9802), owner=Ethan Brooks, eta=15m. Automated rollback watch ON.

Rosa Alvarez: I'll be oncall for the next hour. Will trigger rollback if 1% packet loss or route flap >3 in 5m.

Maya Singh: Final note: QA will run a smoke suite after full rollout. If any failures, we revert module ref and open postmortem.

Deploybot: Prod apply started (jt-9802). Streaming logs to thread.

(7m later)
Deploybot: Prod apply finished: success. run_id=jt-9802. No destructive changes.

Maya Singh: Updated release notes with job links and rollback ladder. Closing change window in 30m.

Ethan Brooks: Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Reminder: Tag infra commit in release tracker and notify #release-announce after QA signs off.
